import hashlib, json, re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin

class Overview(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.hidden = 0
        self.fragments = []
        self.link = None
        self.links = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('script', 'style'):
            self.hidden += 1
        if tag == 'a' and not self.hidden:
            self.link = (dict(attrs).get('href', ''), [])
        if tag in ('p', 'li', 'div', 'br', 'h1', 'h2', 'h3'):
            self.fragments.append('\n')

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ('script', 'style'):
            self.hidden -= 1
        if tag == 'a' and self.link is not None:
            href, parts = self.link
            self.links.append((href, ' '.join(' '.join(parts).split())))
            self.link = None

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.hidden:
            self.fragments.append(data)
            if self.link is not None:
                self.link[1].append(data)

root = Path('products/services/public-data-prize-trial')
source = root / 'raw/gems-official.html'
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '9c649db7ce7f6eade555c2e13ef36c70c43ffe6a155840c3da8d68ad1c480446'
overview = Overview()
overview.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
url = 'https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/'
keywords = re.compile(r'\b(prizes?|deadline|eligib\w*|closed|open|submi\w+|scor\w+|geologic|canada|united states|rules?|payout|artificial intelligence)\b', re.I)
lines = [' '.join(line.split()) for line in ''.join(overview.fragments).splitlines()]
passages = list(dict.fromkeys(line[:800] for line in lines if line and keywords.search(line)))[:45]
links = list(dict.fromkeys((urljoin(url, href), label) for href, label in overview.links if href and keywords.search(label)))[:20]
result = {'source': url, 'source_sha256': digest, 'use': 'Overview excerpts and navigation only. Verify governing terms and full context in the official originals.', 'passages': passages, 'links': [{'url': href, 'label': label} for href, label in links]}
output = root / 'gems-overview-evidence.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
readback = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert readback == result
print(json.dumps({'output': str(output), 'passages': len(passages), 'links': len(links)}))
